entry_item.definition: a) adj. and n. White (also political); light (of color); the white of an egg or of the eye; walleye (cf. cay-a, 3). b) adj. and n, Mourning; white mourning clothing. c) adj. Pure, good, simple; noble, aristocratic. d) adj. Level, smooth, flat. e) adj. Not vaccinated for smallpox.
